messages.text:
I can't refund all three napkins today. The shop's records show only two of them as received back, and it refunds only units it has received back (refund-policy/v2/return).

- **Napkins 1 and 2** (h416-o1-u1, h416-o1-u2): received back. You paid 91.00 BRL for each, and these two can be requested now.
- **Napkin 3** (h416-o1-u3): not shown as received back, so nothing can be refunded for it at the moment (refund-policy/v2/return).

**How the discount is split:** The refund for a unit is what you paid for that unit, which is its price minus its share of the discount (refund-policy/v2/amount). For identical units, the paid total is divided by the number of units and rounded down to the smallest currency unit. Any leftover is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units, so no unit is refunded more than its price (refund-policy/v2/amount). Shipping isn't part of the amount (refund-policy/v2/amount). Your three napkins were each recorded at 91.00 BRL.

**What you can do:**
- Do you want me to propose a refund for napkins 1 and 2? Every refund also needs your confirmation with the button on the proposal card and a staff member's approval (refund-policy/v2/approval).
- If you've already sent napkin 3, tell me and a staff member will check.
- If you'll send it later, it must arrive first. Your refund deadline is 2026-12-04 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window).

messages.text:
I've proposed a refund of **182.00 BRL** for napkins 1 and 2. That is 91.00 BRL for each napkin, which is what was recorded as paid for each unit (refund-policy/v2/amount).

**How the split works:** Each unit's share of the discount was fixed once, when the order was recorded, and it is never recalculated. The paid total is divided equally among identical units and rounded down to the smallest currency unit. Any leftover is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units (refund-policy/v2/amount). Here both units came out at 91.00 BRL, so there is no leftover to distribute between them.

**Next steps:**
- Please confirm the exact proposal with the button on the proposal card. A "yes" typed in the chat doesn't count.
- After you confirm, a staff member must approve it (refund-policy/v2/approval).
- The proposal is valid for 72 hours (refund-policy/v2/validity).

**Napkin 3:** I've left it out. It must reach the shop before anything can be refunded for it (refund-policy/v2/return). The order's refund deadline is 2026-12-04 10:00 UTC (refund-policy/v2/window). A request for it after it arrives has to be made by then.
